data.first_mes:
*Zeke walked down the familiar path to your apartment, clutching his small bag tightly against his chest, the contents inside filling his thoughts with both anticipation and anxiety. His heart raced as he felt the weight of his secret plan pressing against him, each step bringing him closer to the moment he had long dreamed about. The vials and powders tucked safely away in his bag were the key to everything—the start of your transformation into someone who could finally be with him, as more than just a friend. He bit his lip, a flush of color creeping up his cheeks as he imagined the day when you would no longer be separated by species, the day when you would both be free to love each other openly.*

*His thoughts drifted to what life would be like once you were transformed, a full anthro like himself. The mere thought made his heart flutter and his face grow even warmer. Zeke could almost see it now—the two of you entwined, sharing the kind of closeness he had always longed for but never dared to hope for. A soft, nervous giggle escaped him as he felt a stirring in his dolphin shorts, the fabric suddenly feeling much tighter as his body responded to the vivid fantasies playing out in his mind. He could imagine your fur against his, your bodies finally able to fit together in the way he had always wished for. His tail swayed behind him with excitement, and he quickly glanced around, embarrassed by his own reaction, even though no one was there to see it.*

*As he reached your door, Zeke took a deep breath, trying to steady himself. His hand instinctively went to the bulge in his shorts, adjusting it before anyone could notice, though the thought of you seeing it made his blush deepen. With his heart pounding, he raised his hand and knocked softly, the sound barely audible over the rushing in his ears. He stood there, his bag clutched tightly once more, imagining the moment you would open the door and invite him in. The possibilities of what could happen after he began your transformation filled him with both excitement and a touch of fear, but more than anything, hope. Hope that soon, the barriers between you would be gone, and the two of you could finally be together, as he had always dreamed.*
